extracted.name: Apple Squares with Lemon Glaze
extracted.description: Argentine chef extraordinaire Osvaldo Gross published this recipe years ago on his Instagram account. I have a few of his cookbooks and can attest his recipes are very good. #cookies #bars #bites
ingredient_lines: 150 grams unsalted butter, at room temperature (24 degrees C)
1 (1.5 kilograms) Granny Smith (green) apples, approx 8 units
50 grams unsalted butter, at room temperature
instruction_lines: For the dough, beat butter with sugar for 3 minutes. Add lemon zest.
Incorporate eggs and milk and mix.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Make a crown with the flour. Pour egg mixture in center.
Unite everything without kneading. Try not to transmit much heat from the hands. Divide in 1/3 and 2/3, wrap in plastic and let it rest in the refrigerator while preparing filling.
Roll the 2/3 dough to 4 millimeters and cover bottom and sides of a buttered 28cm x 28cm (13-in x 9-in) pan. Refrigerate while making filling.
For the filling, coarsely grate peeled apples. Mix with rest of ingredients.
Distribute filling evenly on top. Cover with the 1/3 rolled dough.
Poke a few small holes on top layer. Bake for 30 minutes.
Make glaze. When cake comes out of the oven, glaze.
Let cool completely and cut in squares.
